answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 slots. Applicants submit sealed bids encrypted with a cipher; the clearing price is the 200th bid. Winners lock the bid for 20 epochs and get a non-transferable umber seal, and taken slots carry a lotus emblem, so one agent cannot claim two. Making 1,000 fakes at 50 units costs 50,000 units locked 20 epochs, far above rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
